name: Generate Video Prompt
purpose: Turns a submitted website URL into a structured, cinematic video-generation prompt.

steps.name: Receive Request
steps.purpose: Accepts the website URL, optional reference images, and tone setting.

steps.name: Validate Request
steps.purpose: Checks the URL and reference images, and normalizes the tone.

edgeCases.name: Malformed or unreachable URL
edgeCases.description: The submitted URL is not a valid http(s) URL.
edgeCases.handling: Returns a 400 with an explanatory error message.

edgeCases.name: Too many reference images
edgeCases.description: More than six reference images are submitted.

steps.name: Check Quota
steps.purpose: Confirms the account has not exceeded its monthly generation quota.

edgeCases.name: Monthly quota exceeded
edgeCases.description: The account has already generated the maximum number of videos this month.

steps.name: Scrape Website
steps.purpose: Fetches the submitted page and extracts its title, description, body text, and images.

edgeCases.name: Website unreachable or returns an error status
edgeCases.description: The fetch fails or the response is not ok.
edgeCases.handling: Returns a 502 without persisting a generation.

steps.name: Understand Product
steps.purpose: Converts the scraped page into a structured product model: name, tagline, summary, hero image, and keywords.

details.implementation: Ranks the most frequent non-trivial words in the scraped body text as keywords, and assumes the first scraped image is representative of the product.
assumptions: The first image found on the page is a reasonable hero image for the product.

steps.name: Generate Story
steps.purpose: Builds a short, tone-appropriate beat sequence (hook, problem, payoff) from the product context.

steps.name: Save Result
steps.purpose: Persists the generation and returns it to the caller, or returns an error response for any failed step above.

connections.label: rejected
connections.condition: URL or reference image validation fails.

connections.label: quota exceeded
connections.condition: The account has reached its monthly generation quota.

connections.label: scrape failed
connections.condition: The website could not be fetched.

notes: Reference implementation shipped as Code Observatory's example project; see examples/motiona.
